mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of UNRATE > 6.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is persistently below its 12-month MA by more than 3% for four months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in HOUST and a decrease in RSAFS over two months signals rising housing demand but falling savings, which may overheat the housing market and increase financial instability, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 0% MoM and RSAFS < 0% MoM for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST rises and RSAFS falls for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A positive co-movement between PAYEMS and UNRATE above their respective 3-month averages for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and supports higher corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 3-month avg and UNRATE > 3-month avg for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and UNRATE exceed their 3-month averages for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in CPIAUCSL below 1% for six consecutive months signals deflationary pressure, which discourages investment and consumption, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL < 1% for six months.

mechanism_narrative: A positive correlation between GDPC1 and INDPRO above 0.7 for three consecutive quarters indicates synchronized growth in output and industrial production, which supports earnings growth and results in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, except during periods of financial crisis.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 and INDPRO are highly correlated for three quarters outside of financial crisis periods.
